“Kaf Ha Ya Ayn Sad”

Two explanations transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 19:1).

551
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās No. 551: 1: 34

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
551: 1:34. Sufyan, from Husayn, from Ismail ibn Rashid, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, on His words
"Kaf Ha Ya Ayn Sad": He said, sufficient, great, guide, trustworthy, mighty, truthful (verse 1).
العربية
551: 1: 34 سفيان عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عن بن عباس في قوله إلا قَالَ كَافٌ كَبِيرٌ هَادٍ أَمِينٌ عزيز صادق (الآية 1) .

24

“I will never pay you until you disbelieve in Muhammad, peace be upon…”

An explanation transmitted from Khabbab (Q 19:77).

590
Explanation from Khabbab No. 590: 40: 12

Khabbab

English
Transmission wording
590: 40:12. Sufyan, from al-Amash, from Abu al-Duha, from Masruq, from Khabbab, who said:
I was a smith in Mecca, and al-As ibn Wail came to me with a sword of his for me to work on. I went to him to ask for my payment. He said, "I will never pay you until you disbelieve in Muhammad, peace be upon him." I said, "No, I will not disbelieve in Muhammad until God makes you die and then resurrects you." He said, "If I die, I will be resurrected with wealth and children" [the next words, apparently mocking the Messenger, are garbled]. So there was revealed: "Have you seen the one who disbelieved in Our verses and said, 'I will surely be given wealth and children'? Has he looked into the unseen, or taken a covenant with the Most Merciful?" to the end of the verse (verse 77).
العربية
590: 40: 12 سفيان عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى عن مسروق عن حباب قَالَ كُنْتُ قَيْنًا بِمَكَّةَ فَجَاءَنِي العاص بن وايل بِسَيْفٍ لَهُ أَعْمَلُهُ فَانْطَلَقْتُ إِلَيْهِ أَتَقَاضَاهُ أَجْرَهُ قَالَ لَا أُعْطِيكَ أبدا حتى تكفر بمحمد ﷺ فقلت لا لَا أَكْفُرُ بِمُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى يُمِيتَكَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثَكَ قَالَ فَإِنِّي إِذَا مِتُّ بُعِثْتُ وَلِي مَالٌ وولد متهاذيا رسول فِي قَوْلِهِ فَنَزَلَتْ أَفَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي كَفَرَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَقَالَ لأُوتَيَنَّ مَالا وَوَلَدًا أَطَّلَعَ الْغَيْبَ أَمِ اتَّخَذَ عند الرحمن عهدا إلى آخر الآية (الآية 77) .
